conclusions.text: All exact issue IDs match named 2018 GeoBoundaries ADM2 source features, unique 2018 and 2025 Census county identities, and the current Texas parent roster.
Texas county is an appropriate administrative tier based on official Texas government and Census county meaning, not the ADM2 code alone.

Twenty-four county assessments (23 numeric-screen signals and one additional source-to-Atlas multipart component-count difference) have unresolved equal-area geometry signals across pinned source/Census comparisons; no specific geometric error or correction is established.
The repository source-catalog digest differs from the exact restored upstream LFS digest; no source-catalog mutation is justified until its original byte basis is understood.

West South Central is the four-state Census division; the current 470 IDs partition into #431 Texas 254 and #432 sibling 216 with no overlap. All 470 current children are named County/ADM2 records with 2018 Public Domain source metadata. This does not certify the combined parent or region geometry.

Texas county identity, state administrative meaning, and the exact 254 member relationship are supported; the Texas province outline remains insufficient-evidence because this packet did not compare it with dated authoritative state boundary geometry.
